rawText:
<observations>
Date: Mar 20 - Mar 29, 2026
* 🔴 User profile & preferences: Prefers coffee from downtown café, listens to jazz/espresso while coding; office cat Luna, office plants (Fern).
* 🔴 Ledgerly project specs: Uses PostgreSQL (switched from SQLite), TypeScript strict mode, semantic commits, LaunchDarkly & ConfigCat feature flags. Public API rate limit: 500 req/min. SOC 2 audit starts May 19, 2026.
* ✅ Completed infrastructure & features: CI/CD caching & Percy visual regression tests, Jest 85% coverage threshold, discount codes (PR #42 @sara), locale date formatting (PR #58 @mike), dark mode UI deployed to staging, bulk Excel (.xlsx) invoice upload via SheetJS.

Date: Apr 2, 2026
* 🟡 (07:10) Created `recurring_invoices` database table and API endpoint `/api/v1/invoices/recurring`.
* 🟡 (11:40) Integrated pdfmake for dynamic PDF watermarks; added BullMQ async processing for PDFs to handle staging CPU spikes.
* ✅ (17:45) Merged branch `feature/recurring-invoices` into develop after approval from @kim.

Date: Apr 6, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User decided to integrate Stripe for subscription payments in Ledgerly.
* 🟡 (07:50) Created `stripeService.ts` and webhook endpoint `/api/v1/payments/stripe/webhook`.
* 🟡 (11:35) Integrated qrcode library to attach QR code links to payment receipt emails.
* 🟡 (15:40) Added nightly DB cleanup cron job and adopted Redis Streams for background job queue (user agreed).
* 🟡 (16:55) Updated CI pipeline to include Snyk security scanning for dependencies.
* ✅ (18:20) Merged branch `feature/stripe-integration` into main after approval from @alex.
</observations>
